exposure: Surgeon type (non-physician surgeon vs. physician surgeon)
cohort: 474 mothers who underwent caesarean section in two hospitals in Ethiopia
finding: Surgical task shifting to non-physician surgeons in Ethiopia does not negatively affect immediate newborn outcomes after caesarean section, although general anesthesia was identified as a factor negatively impacting outcomes.
mod_finding: Surgical task shifting to non-physician surgeons does not negatively affect immediate newborn outcomes after caesarean section.
